inShort: A and B dink together and count out loud: 50 in a row, and a ball in the net sends you back to zero.
rules: A and B face each other at the kitchen line and dink. Count every ball out loud together.
Four rounds of about 2–3 minutes: cross-court from the right half, cross-court from the left half, middle to middle, straight ahead along one sideline.
A ball in the net sends the count back to zero. A ball wide, or one that just trickles over the net, keeps the count going.
No hard hits. If a ball comes up high, roll it back with topspin and keep the pressure on.
Lean forward and keep your feet working. No waiting for the ball.
Reached 50? Keep the same pattern going with a bit more pressure until someone hits the net.
tooEasy: One of you plays faster dinks and tries to force the other into the net. Or raise the target to 75.
goodLooksLike: The rally stays calm and steady, the dinks stay low over the net, and both players lean in.

drill.title: Dink Patterns: Series of 50 (Warm-Up + Pattern Lock)
